status: Relocated on 2026-11-13 with cdprobe relocate (shape search with the 2.04.08 offsets, then the owner route). Only the three class RVAs moved; every object offset, the header and the balance marker are unchanged from 2.04.08. Steam build 26636972.

reserveObject.comment: Heap item object per camp reserve. Offsets are from the object start (its class pointer). All RVAs are relative to the exe's load address.
reserveObject.rules: Count only objects whose parent has ownerClassRva and whose grandparent has rootClassRva (display copies have no parent). Of those, the balance is the object with a non-empty list at balanceListOffset (pointer, then two non-zero u32s); pending changes (negative for costs, positive for gains) and zero placeholders have zeros there. Checked 2026-11-12 in two sessions on 2.04.08; same rule on 2.05.00 (2026-11-13).
